text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki is injured during training, so I escort her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My sincerest apologies. My negligence has caused you concern.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that my treatment is finished, let's get back to training.
choice_data_list: You want to run straight away?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Of course. It doesn't hurt, so there should be no issue.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Besides, this kind of injury is commonplace in the martial arts world.
choice_data_list: Take the rest of the day off just to be safe.
We can train, but let's take things easy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With all due respect, I don't believe that an injury of this nature warrants rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to fall behind. Please allow me to continue training.
choice_data_list: Carelessness is a foe to be feared. We can make up the time once you're back on your feet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haste does make waste. In the martial arts world, it's commonplace to hear of injuries caused by overexertion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I understand. If you insist, I'll rest up and focus my energy on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki sounds slightly disappointed as she sets off back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for understanding. Shall we head to the track?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I test the waters by assigning her a light run, but Yaeno Muteki soon looks pained.
choice_data_list: I was worried this would happen. Let's stop.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Understood. I'll focus on recovering for now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I deeply apologize for dragging you out to the track…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki sounds remorseful as she heads back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whew… A lighter training session should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You needn't be concerned. I'll limit my efforts as a matter of course.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I take pride in having the resolve to weather injuries of this caliber.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki completes a light training session while taking care not to aggravate her injury.
